name: Location lookbook
source: library: the elegant fashion-influencer lookbook (one person, several premium settings, outfit and ambiance), described generically
essence: One elegant person moves through a few beautiful places, each outfit framed with the setting, so the clothes are sold as part of a life worth wanting.
why_it_works: Aspiration: the viewer wants the setting and the clothes together
Saves and shares as outfit inspiration

hook.pattern: a short place-and-mood line, e.g. 'linen season in {place}' or 'what I wore this week'
hook.first_frame: the person mid-stride in the most striking location

sound: a breezy, elegant trending track; soft transitions on the downbeat
needs: clothing, accessories or anything worn or carried
keep: the outfit and the place framed together
a clean product frame before the end
drop: the original influencer's face, name, voice and real locations
